title: Understanding and Detecting Hateful Content using Contrastive Learning
benchmark_measurement: Detection of multimodal (text and image) hateful content, specifically Antisemitism and Islamophobia, on the 4chan /pol/ board.
findings: The study found that OpenAI's CLIP model can detect Antisemitic and Islamophobic imagery with an accuracy of 81% (F1 score = 0.54), outperforming baseline models like MMBT-Grid and MOMENTA. The prevalence of hateful imagery related to these groups on 4chan's /pol/ was found to be similar to that of textual hate speech, highlighting the need for multimodal detection. The volume of hateful content spiked in correlation with real-world events. The authors also noted that the CLIP model exhibited biases, such as associating images of terrorists with text about Muslims.
